idea-plugin.name: Kassi HTTP Data Injector
idea-plugin.description:
Kassi HTTP Data Injector — valid test data straight into your .http requests

Stop hand-typing test IBANs and card numbers into the JetBrains HTTP Client. This plugin inserts spec-valid synthetic data — the same checksummed generators as Kassi Test Data — directly into .http files, formatted for immediate use in a URL, header, or JSON body.

  • IBAN — every European country, ISO 7064 mod-97 valid (plus an invalid variant for negative tests).
  • Card (PAN) — Luhn-valid, from payment-gateway test BIN ranges only, per network (Visa/Mastercard/Amex).
  • BIC/SWIFT — structurally valid, per country.
  • Persona — a coherent identity (name, DOB, address, IBAN, BIC) as a ready-to-paste JSON object.

100% offline and algorithmic. Zero network, zero real PII — every value is synthetic test data covered by a unit test that asserts it passes the real checksum algorithm.

Usage: in a .http file, press Alt+Enter for "Insert test data…", or right-click in the editor, search, pick, and it inserts at the caret.

More Kassi tools for QA & fintech: Kassi Test Data — generate valid IBANs, cards, BIC/SWIFT, VAT and national IDs; and Checksum & Regex Playground.

Source, issues & docs: github.com/VadimToptunov/kassi-plugins
